Risk event: Video footage is not enough to cover all 12 weeks
Contingency plan: Record every meeting from W7. Check total footage at W9. If under 20 min, shoot Scene 2 and Scene 5 in one extra session.
Trigger (how we know it is happening): Under 20 minutes of usable footage by end of W9

Risk event: Team loses momentum after the product is finished in W6
Contingency plan: One task card per person each week plus a Monday text stand-up. Anyone with nothing submitted two weeks in a row gets a private message.
Trigger (how we know it is happening): Two weeks with zero submissions in the group chat

Risk event: Students post items but nobody responds, so they leave
Contingency plan: Push every new listing into the 3 UM second-hand WeChat groups during the first two weeks. Seed the platform with 20 items from team members.
Trigger (how we know it is happening): Three days in a row with zero buy requests

Risk event: Only one member can maintain the code
Contingency plan: Have a second member run the project locally before W8 and record a short setup video. Keep the repo access shared.

Risk event: Sprint records are missing, velocity chart cannot be built
Contingency plan: Hold a retrospective at the end of W7, W9 and W11. Count Done cards in Trello as the number for each sprint.
Trigger (how we know it is happening): No retrospective board by end of W10

Risk event: Final exam period overlaps with report and video deadlines
Contingency plan: Finish the report draft and a rough video cut before W13. Leave W13-W14 for edits only.
Trigger (how we know it is happening): Report below 60 percent complete at end of W12

Risk event: Members are in different countries, coordination is slow
Contingency plan: Everything asynchronous. Trello cards plus a written stand-up every Monday. No meetings longer than 30 minutes.
Trigger (how we know it is happening): A meeting runs past 30 minutes without a decision

Risk event: External collaborator stops replying or never signed
Contingency plan: Switch to the backup contact on our list. Use student test feedback as the review record if no formal meeting happens.

Risk event: Users keep using WeChat groups instead of the platform
Contingency plan: Position the platform as a cleaner version of the WeChat groups, not a replacement. In testing, time how long one deal takes on each side.
Trigger (how we know it is happening): Three of five testers still choose WeChat

Risk event: Some members still have not joined the Trello board
Contingency plan: Unjoined members get covered by someone in the same role. Their names stay on the cards.
Trigger (how we know it is happening): Still not joined by end of W7
